tokens.soon: The access token stops working on {{date}}. Make a new one in Turso and enter it before then, or this device stops copying data.
tokens.expired: The access token expired on {{date}}. Make a new one in Turso and enter it, then this device copies data again.
tokens.hintPhone: Settings → Devices & sync → Change the access token
tokens.hintComputer: Put the new token in TULA_SYNC_TOKEN in Tula's settings file and restart Tula.
